# The device holds a token; elsewhere (the web API: the store directly)
# one entry is added and one deleted. sync-collection with the token
# answers exactly these two: the new one with its ETag, the deleted one
# as a bare 404.
@seed calendar privat 2F0E6A64-1B7C-4E5A-9C1D-6A8E0B3D4C21.ics weekly-team.ics
@seed calendar privat old.ics old-event.ics

> REPORT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/
> Auth: alex
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:sync-collection xmlns:A="DAV:"><A:sync-token/><A:sync-level>1</A:sync-level><A:prop><A:getetag/></A:prop></A:sync-collection>
< status 207
< responses 2
< save token sync-token

@seed calendar privat 6D3B0C8E-5F21-4A77-B0C4-1E9D2A7F3B55.ics dentist.ics
@delete calendar privat old.ics

> REPORT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/
> Auth: alex
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:sync-collection xmlns:A="DAV:"><A:sync-token>{saved:token}</A:sync-token><A:sync-level>1</A:sync-level><A:prop><A:getetag/><A:getcontenttype/></A:prop></A:sync-collection>
< status 207
< responses 2
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/6D3B0C8E-5F21-4A77-B0C4-1E9D2A7F3B55.ics d:getetag {etag:dentist.ics}
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/6D3B0C8E-5F21-4A77-B0C4-1E9D2A7F3B55.ics d:getcontenttype text/calendar
< response /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/old.ics 404
< no-prop /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/old.ics d:getetag
< response-lacks /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/2F0E6A64-1B7C-4E5A-9C1D-6A8E0B3D4C21.ics
< sync-token-not {saved:token}
< save token2 sync-token

# A change of the calendar's properties moves the token but names no entry.
> PROPPATCH /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/
> Auth: alex
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:propertyupdate xmlns:A="DAV:" xmlns:I="http://apple.com/ns/ical/"><A:set><A:prop><I:calendar-color>#FF9500FF</I:calendar-color></A:prop></A:set></A:propertyupdate>
< status 207

> REPORT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/
> Auth: alex
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:sync-collection xmlns:A="DAV:"><A:sync-token>{saved:token2}</A:sync-token><A:sync-level>1</A:sync-level><A:prop><A:getetag/></A:prop></A:sync-collection>
< status 207
< responses 0
< sync-token-not {saved:token2}

# An entry changed twice and then deleted is reported once, deleted.
@seed calendar privat twice.ics running.ics
> REPORT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/
> Auth: alex
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:sync-collection xmlns:A="DAV:"><A:sync-token/><A:sync-level>1</A:sync-level><A:prop><A:getetag/></A:prop></A:sync-collection>
< status 207
< save token3 sync-token

@delete calendar privat twice.ics
@seed calendar privat twice.ics running.ics
@delete calendar privat twice.ics

> REPORT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/
> Auth: alex
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:sync-collection xmlns:A="DAV:"><A:sync-token>{saved:token3}</A:sync-token><A:sync-level>1</A:sync-level><A:prop><A:getetag/></A:prop></A:sync-collection>
< status 207
< responses 1
< response /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/twice.ics 404
